3375.title: Fork eligibility omits archive state
3375.rootCauseOneLine: The shared client fork eligibility helper ignores archivedAt, while the server rejects archived sources.
3375.proposedFix: Reject archived sources in the shared eligibility helper; retain the existing server policy.
3375.caveats: Functional eligibility reproduced twice. Full browser rendering, HTTP submission, desktop and Connect were not replayed.
